candidates.title: The title is Alice's line — and it is broken grammar on purpose
candidates.detail: The episode title is taken from Lewis Carroll's Alice's Adventures in Wonderland, chapter II ('The Pool of Tears'), where Alice exclaims it as she begins to grow. Carroll immediately has the narrator note that she was so surprised she momentarily forgot how to speak good English — the comparative should be 'more curious'. The bad grammar is the joke, and the book flags it itself.
candidates.moment: Not an on-screen moment: the title frames Ted arriving at a version of Richmond where everything familiar has been rearranged.

candidates.title: Alice's ended career is the defining injury story of the women's game
candidates.detail: Alice Chilton is a former footballer whose playing career was cut short by multiple ACL injuries, and Ted wins her over by having learned that. The detail is not invented for drama: ACL rupture is the signature epidemic of elite women's football. A study of the 2022 men's and 2023 women's World Cups found 12.5% of the women's players had undergone a previous ACL reconstruction against 7.7% of the men's; FIFPRO runs a dedicated multi-year study, Project ACL, into why. Roughly two-thirds of these injuries in the women's game happen with no contact at all.
candidates.moment: Ted tells Alice he knows her story; the episode also has striker Josie go down with a season-ending injury in training.

candidates.title: He does not persuade her — he pays attention to her
candidates.detail: Ted does not win Alice round with optimism or a speech. He wins her by having gone and learned what happened to her, and reflecting it back. The philosophical frame is attention as a moral act: Simone Weil's claim that attention is the rarest and purest form of generosity (from a 1942 letter to Joe Bousquet), and Kant's respect for persons, already used in this project — treat people as ends, never merely as means. VERIFY THE WEIL ATTRIBUTION before shipping; it is widely quoted and the reviewer should confirm the letter, not a quote site.

candidates.title: A 1985 feminist anthem lands on the Lady Greyhounds

candidates.title: The season's real subject is starting over without the old advantages
candidates.detail: Every recap lands on the same throughline: Ted cannot rerun the season-one playbook. He arrives with a reputation instead of anonymity, meets scepticism rather than a squad ready to be charmed, and has to build a culture for people whose situation is not the men's team's. Alice is the episode's embodiment of that resistance.
